item.title: Both 30 mph signs not at all visible., 21st July
item.description:
This has been an ongoing issue for months. Local council have been involved with highways. And absolutely nothing has been done. This is far beyond a danger as cars drive up through the 30mph at 60 mph as the signs are so badly hidden in the hedges you can tell what speed it is as there is no street lights people assume it is still 60mph as the 30mph signs are invisible. Danger and dangerous. Needs fixing straight away.

item.title: Reported in May 2026, 21st July
item.description:
Along the stretch from GE Roundabout all the way down to the 30mph speed change before the racecourse Roundabout there are hardly any 40mph signs amd the ones thst are there are so set back from the road they are very difficult to see. I believe there are supposed to be a set distance and I feel this stretch of road could do with more due to the nature of the road and the fact it use to be a National speed limit 60mph so people dont see the signs set far back from the road and still treat it like a 60mph road. Originally reported in May 26. Nothing has been done since.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Evesham Road, Marle Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
